evidence_quote_policy: Judge selects a candidate-only evidence span ID from a strict schema enum. The evaluator copies the exact answer/profile substring; the judge cannot write a quote. Criterion keys are strict required schema properties.
model_family_limitation: Judge and candidate use the same model family; correlated errors remain possible.
exact_policy: Whole numeric/date/text match plus unit and citation guards; semantic judge must also pass.
tool_policy: First actual tool span, exact name and schema-valid arguments; no later-call substitution.
open_answer_policy: All standard and task-specific criteria must pass; no weighted average.
judge_error_policy: Keep an explicit ungraded/error status; never silently pass or drop it.
human_calibration_policy: Report observed labels only, exclude skipped labels, do not claim a 50-answer review.
